# ShipReady

> ShipReady is a pre-deploy site audit tool for web agencies and developers.
> Scan any URL to get evidence-backed findings across performance, SEO, security,
> mobile readiness, and AI visibility — with actionable fix prompts for Cursor,
> Claude Code, and Windsurf.

## Description

ShipReady runs 35+ automated checks across five audit categories and produces
a structured report with evidence-grounded confidence ratings: verified
(deterministic from HTTP/HTML signals), likely (AI inference from clear signals),
and heuristic (AI inference from ambiguous signals). Every finding includes the
specific signal that triggered it, eliminating guesswork.

The scan runs in two phases: a Fast Truth Pass (under 30 seconds) covering
security headers, meta tags, robots.txt, and sitemap validity, followed by a
Deep Pass using Lighthouse and AI enrichment to generate business-context-aware
recommendations. Fix prompts are specific to the detected tech stack — a
Shopify store gets Liquid file references; a Next.js app gets component-level
instructions.

Primary audience: small web/dev agencies (1–15 people) who audit client sites
before delivery. Secondary audience: SEO and marketing agencies adding AI
visibility audits to their service offering.

## Author

ShipReady — https://ship-ready.vercel.app

## Key concepts

- Verified / likely / heuristic confidence model
- Fast Truth Pass (under 30s) + Deep Pass (Lighthouse + AI enrichment)
- Business Context Engine — auto-detects stack, business type, primary CTA
- Evidence-backed findings with source attribution (no invented issues)
- Fix prompts scoped to detected tech stack (Next.js, Shopify, WordPress, etc.)

## FAQ

Q: What does ShipReady check?
A: Performance (Lighthouse LCP, CLS, INP, FCP), SEO (titles, meta descriptions,
canonicals, sitemap, robots.txt, structured data), security (HTTP headers: HSTS,
CSP, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy), mobile readiness
(viewport, tap targets, font sizes, responsive layout), and AI visibility
(llms.txt, AI crawler access, FAQ schema, author entity, structured data quality).

Q: How long does a scan take?
A: Initial findings appear in under 30 seconds (Fast Truth Pass). The full
report with Lighthouse scores and AI fix prompts takes 1–3 minutes.

Q: What are verified, likely, and heuristic findings?
A: Verified findings are extracted directly from HTTP responses or HTML without
inference and always affect the score. Likely findings use AI with clear
supporting signals. Heuristic findings are AI inference from ambiguous signals.
Only verified and score-eligible findings affect the overall score.

Q: Who is ShipReady for?
A: Web and dev agencies auditing client sites before delivery, freelance
developers doing pre-launch quality checks, and SEO agencies adding AI
visibility auditing to their service offering.

Q: What AI tools are the fix prompts designed for?
A: Cursor, Claude Code, and Windsurf. Prompts reference specific files and
configuration paths for the detected tech stack.
